_comment: Inertia calculation formulas and templates for common geometries

box.description: Rectangular box with dimensions [width, height, depth]
box.mass_formula: mass = volume * density = width * height * depth * density
box.typical_density: 500-1000 kg/m³ for plastic, 2700 for aluminum, 7800 for steel
box.urdf_template:
<inertial>
  <mass value='0.5'/>
  <origin xyz='0 0 0' rpy='0 0 0'/>
  <inertia ixx='0.000833' ixy='0' ixz='0' iyy='0.000833' iyz='0' izz='0.000833'/>
</inertial>

cylinder.description: Cylinder with radius r and length (height) h

inertia_tensor._note: Assuming cylinder axis is along Z

cylinder.urdf_template:
<inertial>
  <mass value='1.0'/>
  <origin xyz='0 0 0' rpy='0 0 0'/>
  <inertia ixx='0.003542' ixy='0' ixz='0' iyy='0.003542' iyz='0' izz='0.00125'/>
</inertial>

sphere.urdf_template:
<inertial>
  <mass value='0.5'/>
  <origin xyz='0 0 0' rpy='0 0 0'/>
  <inertia ixx='0.0005' ixy='0' ixz='0' iyy='0.0005' iyz='0' izz='0.0005'/>
</inertial>

capsule.description: Cylinder with hemispherical caps (radius r, cylinder length h)

inertia_tensor._note: Approximate for capsule along Z axis

physical_validity.off_diagonal_small: |ixy|, |ixz|, |iyz| typically << diagonal elements for symmetric bodies

practical_tips.approximation: For complex shapes, approximate with combination of primitives
practical_tips.parallel_axis_theorem: I_new = I_cm + mass * d², where d is distance from original axis to new axis
practical_tips.mesh_inertia: Use CAD software or Drake's CalcSpatialInertia for complex meshes
practical_tips.debugging: If simulation explodes or robot vibrates, check inertia values first

parameters.p_PScm_E: Center of mass position [x, y, z]
